title: China-to-Pakistan Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical and Mechanical Safety of the Tool
rows.target_requirement: Pakistan generally adopts IEC product-safety standards as Pakistan Standards (PS). For motor-operated hand-held, transportable, and garden tools the relevant safety basis is PS/IEC 62841. Pakistan grid voltage is 230 V, 50 Hz, so the tool body, mains plug, cord, and any charger or external supply must be rated and constructed for 230 V, 50 Hz single-phase mains. Where the tool is on the PSQCA Conformity Assessment list, a PSQCA conformity certificate and marking are required before sale.
target_standards: PS/IEC 62841 series (Pakistan Standard adopting IEC 62841 for motor-operated hand-held, transportable, and garden tools)
PSQCA Act 1996 conformity assessment and marking where the product is listed
230 V, 50 Hz single-phase mains rating for tool, plug, cord, and charger
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly use the GB/T 3883 series (adopting IEC 62841) for hand-held, transportable, and garden tools, with separate charger evidence where applicable. GB/T evidence is technically close because both derive from IEC 62841, but it does not by itself create Pakistan market access, PSQCA conformity, or 230 V mains suitability.
china_standards: China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: The technical safety gap is small because both GB/T 3883 and PS/IEC 62841 trace to IEC 62841, but the report must reflect 230 V, 50 Hz mains rather than China's 220/380 V, and the importer still needs PSQCA conformity and marking where the tool is listed. A GB/T report alone does not establish Pakistan market access.

target.en: Mandatory where the tool is on the PSQCA Conformity Assessment list: PSQCA conformity and marking against the adopted PS/IEC 62841 safety basis. The adopted PS/IEC standard is the technical basis; PSQCA conformity is the legal market-access act.
target.zh: 当工具列入 PSQCA 合格评定清单时为强制：按采用的 PS/IEC 62841 安全基础完成 PSQCA 合格评定与标识。采用的 PS/IEC 标准是技术基础；PSQCA 合格评定是法定市场准入行为。
target.zht: 當工具列入 PSQCA 合格評定清單時為強制：按採用的 PS/IEC 62841 安全基礎完成 PSQCA 合格評定與標識。採用的 PS/IEC 標準是技術基礎；PSQCA 合格評定是法定市場准入行為。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses the GB/T 3883 series for in-scope power tools.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常对适用电动工具采用 GB/T 3883 系列。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常對適用電動工具採用 GB/T 3883 系列。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Likely close on technical safety because GB/T 3883 and PS/IEC 62841 share an IEC 62841 origin, but not Pakistan-ready until the documentation reflects 230 V, 50 Hz mains and, where listed, PSQCA conformity and marking are obtained.

source.publisher: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority (PSQCA)

rows.target_requirement: Pakistan does not operate an EU-style horizontal EMC Directive. EMC is addressed through adopted PS/IEC and PS/CISPR standards (for example the CISPR 14 family for motor-operated appliances and tools) where the product type is covered by a PSQCA conformity scheme, and through PTA requirements for the radio part of wireless or cordless tools. There is no single standalone Pakistan EMC marking equivalent to the EU CE EMC route; obligations attach via PSQCA conformity and PTA approval rather than a horizontal EMC law.
target_standards: PS/CISPR 14 family (adopted IEC/CISPR EMC standards for motor-operated tools) where invoked by a PSQCA scheme
PSQCA Act 1996 conformity assessment where the product is listed
PTA type approval for the radio function of wireless or cordless tools
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC reports to GB 4343 / GB 17743 (China adoptions of CISPR 14 / CISPR 15) alongside GB/T 3883 safety reports. The test basis is similar in origin, but Pakistan acceptance depends on whether the product is within a PSQCA scheme and on PTA approval for any radio module, not on China domestic EMC certificates.
china_standards: GB 4343 / GB 17743 (China adoptions of CISPR 14 / CISPR 15) where applicable
rows.gap: There is no single Pakistan EMC marking to obtain. The exporter should confirm whether the tool type falls under a PSQCA conformity scheme that invokes EMC standards and, separately, route any radio module through PTA. A China EMC certificate does not automatically transfer; the practical gap is identifying the correct Pakistan route rather than re-testing to a wholly different limit set.

target.en: No standalone horizontal EMC law in Pakistan. EMC duties arise conditionally: through PSQCA conformity where the product type is listed, and through mandatory PTA approval for the radio function of wireless or cordless tools.
target.zh: 巴基斯坦没有独立的横向 EMC 法律。EMC 义务有条件产生：当产品类型列入清单时通过 PSQCA 合格评定，以及对无线或无绳工具的无线电功能通过强制 PTA 核准。
target.zht: 巴基斯坦沒有獨立的橫向 EMC 法律。EMC 義務有條件產生：當產品類型列入清單時透過 PSQCA 合格評定，以及對無線或無繩工具的無線電功能透過強制 PTA 核准。

cn.en: China domestic files may include GB 4343 / GB 17743 EMC evidence where applicable, but this is China-side evidence only.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件在适用时可包含 GB 4343 / GB 17743 EMC 证据，但这仅为中国侧证据。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件在適用時可包含 GB 4343 / GB 17743 EMC 證據，但這僅為中國側證據。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Pakistan has no horizontal EMC marking equivalent to the EU EMC Directive; treat EMC as conditional under any applicable PSQCA scheme and route the radio module of cordless or wireless tools through PTA type approval before relying on China EMC certificates.

rows.requirement: PSQCA Market Access, Marking, and Import Path
rows.target_requirement: Pakistan market access is governed by PSQCA under the PSQCA Act 1996. Where a product type is on the PSQCA Conformity Assessment list, a conformity certificate and PSQCA marking are mandatory before sale, and goods clear via ports such as Karachi and Port Qasim with an in-country importer of record. Energy-using products may also fall under NEECA energy-efficiency measures. There is no single CE-style mark; obligations are product-list-driven through PSQCA plus PTA for radio.
target_standards: PSQCA Act 1996 and Conformity Assessment / mandatory marking list
PTA type approval for radio function of wireless or cordless tools
NEECA energy-efficiency measures where the product is an energy-using item
In-country importer of record; clearance via Karachi / Port Qasim
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series and, where applicable, CCC for the China domestic market. CCC and GB/T evidence do not confer Pakistan market access: they do not replace PSQCA conformity, PSQCA marking, PTA radio approval, or the in-country importer arrangement.
china_standards: CCC (China Compulsory Certification) where applicable to the China domestic market
rows.gap: A China domestic certificate (GB/T or CCC) is not enough for Pakistan placement. The importer needs PSQCA conformity and marking where the tool is listed, PTA approval for any radio module, an in-country importer of record, and screening against NEECA where the product is energy-using, all mapped to the Pakistan legal framework rather than the EU CE framework.

target.en: Mandatory where listed: PSQCA conformity and marking under the PSQCA Act 1996. Mandatory for radio function: PTA type approval. NEECA energy-efficiency measures apply where the product is an in-scope energy-using item.
target.zh: 列名时强制：依《PSQCA 法 1996》取得 PSQCA 合格评定与标识。无线电功能强制：PTA 型号核准。当产品为适用耗能品时适用 NEECA 能效措施。
target.zht: 列名時強制：依《PSQCA 法 1996》取得 PSQCA 合格評定與標識。無線電功能強制：PTA 型號核准。當產品為適用耗能品時適用 NEECA 能效措施。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses the GB/T 3883 series, with CCC where applicable to the China market.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，并在适用于中国市场时采用 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，並在適用於中國市場時採用 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Pakistan-ready on GB/T or CCC evidence alone; obtain PSQCA conformity and marking where the tool is listed, PTA approval for any radio module, an in-country importer, and NEECA screening for energy-using products before placement.

source.publisher: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority (PSQCA)

rows.target_requirement: Pakistan has no equivalent of the EU outdoor-noise marking and conformity regime (the EU Directive 2000/14/EC). There is no general legal requirement to apply a guaranteed sound-power-level marking or a noise conformity-assessment procedure to power tools or outdoor garden equipment as a condition of placing them on the Pakistan market. Workplace and ambient noise may be addressed through occupational health and environmental rules at the user or site level, but that is not a product-marking obligation on the exporter.
target_standards: No Pakistan equivalent to EU Directive 2000/14/EC outdoor-noise marking
Occupational and environmental noise handled at user or site level, not as a product-marking duty
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 safety evidence focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards and does not include an EU-style outdoor-noise marking. China declares tool noise data informationally under product and labour-safety practice, but this is not an export marking obligation for Pakistan.
china_standards: China domestic noise declaration practice where applicable
rows.gap: Honestly, there is no Pakistan outdoor-noise marking gap to close, because Pakistan does not impose an EU-style 2000/14/EC marking obligation. Exporters should not carry over an EU noise-marking step as if Pakistan required it; declared noise data may still be useful commercially or for site-level safety, but it is not a market-access condition.

target.en: Not a mandatory product-marking obligation in Pakistan. There is no outdoor-noise conformity or guaranteed sound-power marking requirement equivalent to the EU regime as a condition of market placement.
target.zh: 在巴基斯坦不是强制性产品标识义务。不存在等同于欧盟制度、并作为市场投放前提的户外噪声符合性或保证声功率标识要求。
target.zht: 在巴基斯坦不是強制性產品標識義務。不存在等同於歐盟制度、並作為市場投放前提的戶外噪聲符合性或保證聲功率標識要求。

cn.en: China GB/T 3883 evidence does not include EU-style outdoor-noise marking, which is consistent with Pakistan also not requiring it.
cn.zh: 中国 GB/T 3883 证据不包含欧盟式户外噪声标识，这与巴基斯坦同样不要求相一致。
cn.zht: 中國 GB/T 3883 證據不包含歐盟式戶外噪聲標識，這與巴基斯坦同樣不要求相一致。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No Pakistan outdoor-noise marking obligation applies; unlike the EU, Pakistan has no Directive 2000/14/EC equivalent, so an EU noise-marking step should not be presented as a Pakistan market-access requirement.

source.publisher: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority (PSQCA)

rows.target_requirement: Pakistan does not operate an EU-style horizontal RoHS restricted-substances regime for electrical and electronic equipment as a general condition of market placement. There is no single Pakistan law equivalent to EU Directive 2011/65/EU requiring homogeneous-material substance limits, exemption logic, and a declaration for power tools and chargers. Substance control is partial and sectoral, mainly through general chemical, environmental, and import rules rather than a product-level RoHS marking.
target_standards: No Pakistan horizontal RoHS equivalent to EU Directive 2011/65/EU
General chemical, environmental, and import rules apply at a sectoral level rather than as a product RoHS marking
rows.china_equivalent: China operates China RoHS (GB/T 26572 substance limits and SJ/T 11364 marking) for electrical and electronic products, alongside GB/T 3883 safety evidence. This material evidence is useful, but Pakistan does not require it to be mapped to a horizontal RoHS marking as a market-access condition.
china_standards: China RoHS (GB/T 26572 substance limits, SJ/T 11364 marking)
rows.gap: Honestly, there is no Pakistan horizontal RoHS gap to close as a market-access duty, because Pakistan has no RoHS equivalent. Existing China RoHS material evidence is reusable for buyer due diligence, but exporters should not treat an EU-style RoHS declaration as a Pakistan placement requirement. Sectoral chemical and import controls should still be checked case by case.

target.en: Not a mandatory horizontal product obligation in Pakistan; there is no RoHS equivalent to EU Directive 2011/65/EU as a market-access condition. Only sectoral chemical or import rules may apply.
target.zh: 在巴基斯坦不是强制性横向产品义务；不存在作为市场准入条件、等同于欧盟指令 2011/65/EU 的 RoHS。仅可能适用分行业化学品或进口规则。
target.zht: 在巴基斯坦不是強制性橫向產品義務；不存在作為市場准入條件、等同於歐盟指令 2011/65/EU 的 RoHS。僅可能適用分行業化學品或進口規則。

cn.en: China RoHS (GB/T 26572 / SJ/T 11364) is the mandatory China domestic substance baseline for in-scope electrical and electronic products.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS（GB/T 26572 / SJ/T 11364）是适用电气电子产品的中国境内强制物质基线。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS（GB/T 26572 / SJ/T 11364）是適用電氣電子產品的中國境內強制物質基線。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No Pakistan horizontal RoHS marking obligation applies; China RoHS material evidence is reusable for due diligence, but an EU-style RoHS declaration should not be presented as a Pakistan market-access requirement.

source.publisher: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority (PSQCA)

rows.target_requirement: Pakistan has no equivalent of the EU Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 with its battery CE marking, carbon and due-diligence duties, removability rules, and battery passport. For cordless power tools, the lithium battery pack is handled mainly as part of product safety under the adopted PS/IEC basis, plus normal lithium-battery transport safety (UN 38.3 for shipment) and any PTA approval for wireless function. There is no standalone Pakistan battery economic-operator marking regime attached to the pack.
target_standards: No Pakistan equivalent to EU Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542
Lithium battery pack covered under adopted PS/IEC product-safety basis
UN 38.3 lithium-battery transport safety for shipment
PTA type approval for the radio function of cordless or wireless tools
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files commonly treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool, with separate lithium-battery safety (for example GB 31241) and UN 38.3 transport evidence. This evidence largely maps to what Pakistan needs, because Pakistan does not add an EU-style horizontal battery regulation.
china_standards: GB 31241 (China lithium-ion battery safety for portable electronics) where applicable
rows.gap: Honestly, the battery-specific market-access gap is much smaller than the EU. Pakistan does not require a battery CE mark, battery passport, removability analysis, or battery economic-operator duties. The practical needs are product safety of the tool-plus-pack under the adopted PS/IEC basis, UN 38.3 for transport, and PTA for any radio module; an EU battery-regulation step should not be carried over as a Pakistan requirement.

target.en: No standalone EU-style battery regulation in Pakistan. Mandatory elements are limited to product safety of the cordless tool under the adopted PS/IEC basis (with PSQCA conformity where listed), UN 38.3 for transport, and PTA approval for the radio function.
target.zh: 巴基斯坦没有独立的欧盟式电池法规。强制要素限于无绳工具按采用的 PS/IEC 基础的产品安全（列名时取得 PSQCA 合格评定）、运输按 UN 38.3，以及无线电功能的 PTA 核准。
target.zht: 巴基斯坦沒有獨立的歐盟式電池法規。強制要素限於無繩工具按採用的 PS/IEC 基礎的產品安全（列名時取得 PSQCA 合格評定）、運輸按 UN 38.3，以及無線電功能的 PTA 核准。

cn.en: China lithium-battery safety (for example GB 31241) and UN 38.3 transport evidence form the common China-side baseline for tool battery packs.
cn.zh: 中国锂电池安全（例如 GB 31241）和 UN 38.3 运输证据构成工具电池包常见的中国侧基线。
cn.zht: 中國鋰電池安全（例如 GB 31241）和 UN 38.3 運輸證據構成工具電池包常見的中國側基線。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Pakistan has no EU-style battery regulation; for cordless tools focus on PS/IEC product safety of the tool-and-pack, UN 38.3 transport, and PTA radio approval, and do not present an EU battery-CE or battery-passport step as a Pakistan requirement.
